case.summary: An analyst requested a review of transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 due to unusual device activity. The investigation confirmed fraud, as the transaction was made online via an anonymous proxy using a device profile linked to 19 other cards. The card's history was almost entirely in-person, making this online activity highly anomalous. The bank will block the card, file a SAR, and monitor the connected cards.

sar.narrative: This report details suspected fraudulent activity involving customer C13487 and card C13487-K1. Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22, two online transactions were conducted, totaling $187.33. The flagged transaction, 3478561, occurred on 2016-11-22 at 16:11:00 for $74.96 in billing region 191.0. The purchase was initiated from a new device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) and routed through an anonymous proxy. This activity is highly suspicious because the card's historical usage is almost exclusively in-person, with only 2 of 71 earlier transactions being online. Furthermore, network analysis revealed that the same device profile was used on 19 other cards belonging to 19 different customers between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-22. In 24 of those instances, the device was marked as new and operated behind an anonymizing proxy. This indicates a coordinated effort to exploit multiple accounts using a single device setup. The total exposure for this card is $187.33.
